title: Forja dos Mil Golpes
prompt:
SIMPLE FLAT 2D CEL-SHADED COMIC DRAWING, NOT a painting or realistic object render. Dynamic modern independent comic and contemporary animation illustration. Expressive organic confident varied-weight ink lines: heavier accents, thin interior strokes, a few loose energetic sketch marks. LARGE FLAT SOLID COLOR SHAPES, only 2 or 3 discrete color tones per surface; HARD-EDGED BLOCK CEL SHADOWS. Visible printed HALFTONE DOT patches within shadow blocks, not watercolor washes or grainy painterly shading. Warm earthy ochre/orange/rust/brown balanced with cool muted blue/cyan/deep green. Adventurous warm lively mood. NO soft color transitions, airbrush, smooth gradients, photographic lighting, embossed realistic metal, 3D, neon or glossy rendered surfaces.
RPG catalog image 147 Forja dos Mil Golpes. Subject: Forja dos Mil Golpes: forja gigantesca de pedra negra, bigornas do tamanho de casas, martelos que batem sozinhos, rios de metal em brasa, fumaça e faíscas vermelhas. Sinais de magia vermelho-ferrugem no ar.
Landscape 3:2. Retain the described environment as a wide coherent isolated terrain/architecture vignette with organic irregular outer edges. Transparent empty exterior and gaps. No rectangular sky/backdrop fill or foreground characters.
Magic if requested: isolated bold FLAT graphic uniform aura, overflowing aura with gaps, smoke wisps or solid colored hard-light constructs, with halftone dotted glow, no fog halo. Value colors: Conflitüo rusty red; Sublimeyn silver; Dominum dark purple; Persona coral; Alvorum gold/black; Morbidyum pale green; Cognitium indigo; Eternyr midnight blue/white streaks; Primitivum moss green/amber. Contrast warm magic with cool details and cold magic with warm details. When metal is needed, Bronze Arco is dark golden bronze with SIMPLE FLAT tones, no rendered glints. Transparent ALPHA background with wide clear margins around full subject and transparent gaps between separate elements; no white background, checkerboard, backdrop haze or shadow floor. No text, letters, logos, signatures or watermark. No graphic injuries or gore, no victims; human figures wear appropriate practical clothing and are not sexualized.
